newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Christmas tree maker Boto seen in HK$160 mln IPO.
newsitem.headline: Christmas tree maker Boto seen in HK$160 mln IPO.

text.p: Artificial Christmas tree maker Boto Co Ltd is expected to raise about HK$160 million in an initial public offering (IPO) of shares in Hong Kong, market sources said on Tuesday.

Sources said Boto is expected to issue 125.4 million new shares, representing 25 percent of the company's enlarged share capital, at HK$1.28 per share, giving a market capitalisation of about HK$642 million.
The issue price represents a price-earnings multiple of 7.8 times on a fully-diluted basis and 6.02 times on a weighted average basis, sources said.

"Capital raised is expected to be used to expand its production facilities in its manufacturing plants in Shenzhen (in China) and for the manufacture of PVC," said one analyst after attending a listing presentation on Tuesday.
PVC, polyvinyl chloride, is a vinyl plastic used as a rubber substitute.
Sources said the U.S. market accounted for about 68 percent of the company's turnover for the year ended in March 1996. Boto also exports products to Europe, they said.
Boto is also planning to develop its markets in China and South Africa, sources said.
